'''Voltkit''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Voltling]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Voltkit once followed the footsteps of a personal hero to save a Tatari, and that's how the scar came to be. It was also the moment Voltkit realized justice trumps fear."

Voltkit is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A tiny, yellow and white wolf cub that wears a red bandana around its neck and has a scar on one eye.

Voltkit's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces yellow with blue and red with yellow.

== Evolution Trial ==
Voltkit's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Voltling]] you need to complete the following task:
* Bring Voltkit to [[Zobo Horde Invasion|Horde Invasion]] 3 times. May justice overcome fear!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "The scar on Voltkit's eye is just a sticker tattoo. We don't approve of tattoos on babies!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Even as a suckling cub, Voltkit started practicing howling to the moon. Now a racing contest with [[Zappur]] will show who's the real boss."
